<!--
SHARED BODY OF THE "Before we start" SECTION, for every dplyr lesson (find, summarise, chart) — pull it
into a lesson with Quarto's include shortcode, naming this file (see the "Before we start" section of
find.qmd for a working example).

NOTE: do not write that shortcode literally in this file, not even inside a comment like this one. Quarto
resolves include shortcodes in a text pass that does not respect HTML comments, so a file naming itself
includes itself, and the render dies with "Maximum call stack size exceeded".

Every lesson from 3 onwards opens exactly the same way: same example table, same first-load warning, same
records panel. Written out per lesson it had already drifted into three versions differing only in wording
("the same five rows as before" / "as the last lesson" / nothing at all) — three chances to say something
slightly less clear, and three files to edit whenever the panel changes.

The `## Before we start` heading stays in each LESSON rather than living here, so a lesson can put a line
of its own between the heading and this body: find.qmd introduces dplyr by name that way, and it has to
read before the boxes, not after them. Quarto resolves nested includes, so the three inner ones work from
whichever lesson pulls this file in.
-->
